verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents the Pipelines API and Track API for getting customer data in, including customer identification (create/update). It also documents explicit API-driven suppression and deletion by sending 'Suppress Person' / 'Delete Person' track events, and a probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of setting custom attributes/properties on profiles via API, evidence of production-scale behavior (batch endpoints, rate limits, throughput), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
